cases.prompt: What happened in crypto this week, and what can I do on Hyperliquid?
cases.expectedUserOutcome: Answer both halves: use current external evidence for the news summary and Avalon's own capability truth for what the user can do, keeping those sources distinct.
cases.actualResponse:
Here's what's been moving in crypto this week, and what you can do on Hyperliquid:

### Crypto This Week (Late August–Early September 2026)

**Bitcoin & ETFs**
- Bitcoin has been hovering around $79,000–$81,000, with the four-year cycle debate heating up. Some analysts warn the cycle completion later this year could bring another drawdown, while others see it trading more like an "amplified version of gold" [5](https://www.investing.com/news/cryptocurrency-news)[7](https://fortune.com/section/crypto/).
- US Bitcoin ETFs recorded their largest single-day inflow since January — $731 million — and the week of Aug 15–21 saw $2.6 billion in combined BTC/ETH ETF inflows, the strongest since October 2024 [3](https://www.theblock.co/directory/archive/2026)[8](https://www.theblock.co/)[10](https://www.theblock.co/directory/archive/2026/8).
- MicroStrategy (Strategy) continues its mixed playbook: $369.7M in BTC purchases last week, but also ongoing BTC sales [2](https://crypto.com/en/market-updates/weekender-news-aug-15-2026)[6](https://www.barrons.com/topics/cryptocurrencies).

**Altcoins**
- Solana was the standout, jumping to ~$102 [9](https://www.riotimesonline.com/crypto-markets-bitcoin-majors-thursday-august-27-2026/).
- Zcash topped $1,000 on ETF inflow momentum and miner accumulation [3](https://www.theblock.co/directory/archive/2026)[8](https://www.theblock.co/).
- XRP led a broad altcoin rally earlier in August but has pulled back slightly as traders trimmed leveraged positions [9](https://www.riotimesonline.com/crypto-markets-bitcoin-majors-thursday-august-27-2026/)[10](https://www.theblock.co/directory/archive/2026/8).

**Regulation & Institutional**
- The SEC abruptly canceled a scheduled crypto vote, adding regulatory uncertainty [2](https://crypto.com/en/market-updates/weekender-news-aug-15-2026).
- President Trump publicly said he wants Hyperliquid to enter the US, which would be a major milestone for the exchange [3](https://www.theblock.co/directory/archive/2026)[8](https://www.theblock.co/).
- Standard Chartered launched institutional spot crypto trading (BTC and ETH) in the UAE, the first G-SIB to do so in the Gulf [1](https://www.reuters.com/markets/cryptocurrency/).
- Charles Schwab is expanding its direct crypto offerings for clients [6](https://www.barrons.com/topics/cryptocurrencies).

**Hyperliquid-specific**
- UBS, Jane Street, and others hold a combined $75M in Hyperliquid ETF holdings, signaling growing institutional interest [8](https://www.theblock.co/).

---

### What You Can Do on Hyperliquid (via Avalon)

**1. Trade Perpetuals — Crypto, Stocks, Commodities**
- Long or short with leverage on crypto perpetuals (BTC, ETH, SOL, etc.) and HIP-3 equity/commodity-reference perpetuals (NVDA, TSLA, SP500, GOLD, CL, and more). These provide price exposure only — no actual shares or shareholder rights. Note that liquidity on equity perps is thinner than on major crypto perps.

**2. Backtest Strategies First**
- Before going live, I can backtest any Hyperliquid strategy on historical data so you can see how it would have performed.

**3. Set Up Live Agents**
- Once you're happy with a strategy, you can deploy a live perpetuals agent. You fund and authorize an agent wallet once, and it trades autonomously within your set parameters — no per-trade signatures needed.

**4. Watch-Only Mode**
- If you want to observe a market with zero risk, I can set up a read-only agent that tracks price action and signals.

Avalon currently supports Hyperliquid perpetuals (not spot), and product support doesn't guarantee your account is connected or funded yet — we'd need to confirm that before trading.

Want me to backtest a strategy on Hyperliquid, or set up a watch-only agent for a market you're tracking?
